00431.indication: Advanced unresectable/metastatic melanoma in adults; not adjuvant melanoma.

schedule.induction: Nivolumab1mg/kg IV + ipilimumab3mg/kg IV day1 every21days for4cycles. Each infusion30minutes.
schedule.maintenance_switch_wait: q14→q28:14days after last q14 dose; q28→q14:28days after last q28 dose.
schedule.melanoma_duration: Until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity; no preset total maintenance cycle count.
schedule.card_tracking: Track4combination cycles, followed by open-ended maintenance records; do not show4stamps as completion of the entire treatment.
schedule.hcc_distinction: Source now also includes first-line unresectable/advanced HCC. First maintenance21days irrespective of schedule; monotherapy phase up to24months. HCC suite not completed in this batch.

tests.imaging: Consultant treatment plan; no invented mandatory fixed scan interval or tumour-marker schedule.
tests.infusion_observations: For ipilimumab: temperature,pulse,BP every30minutes during infusion and for1hour after completion.
tests.after_treatment: Ongoing vigilance/monitoring at least5months after the last dose; immune reactions may appear after treatment stops.

supportive_care.induction: Low emetogenic potential from ipilimumab; local antiemetic policy. Routine premedication not usually required.
supportive_care.maintenance: Nivolumab minimal emetogenic potential; do not carry an induction low-risk prescription automatically into maintenance.
supportive_care.immune_toxicity: Specialist steroids/other immune suppression only when indicated. Steroid taper after improvement at least1month; infection prophylaxis during immune suppression per source/local policy. No restart during immunosuppressive dosing or other immune suppression.

consent_risks: Thyroid,pituitary,adrenal and diabetes effects that can need long-term replacement
Rash and rare severe blistering skin reactions
Myocarditis,neurological/muscle effects and overlap syndromes requiring urgent assessment
Potential serious/fatal immune reactions and delayed reactions after treatment
00431.reproductive: Pregnancy requires consultant benefit/risk assessment; effective contraception≥5months after nivolumab. Do not invent a breastfeeding instruction from this source; confirm product information.
00431.evidence_attribution: NCCP cites CheckMate067 for advanced melanoma and CheckMate9DW for HCC. Keep evidence cohorts separate; no HCC/adjuvant benefit number on advanced-melanoma card without a separately verified study.
assessment_notes: Grade3 colitis permanently stops even in follow-on nivolumab monotherapy.
CTCAEv4 from source; actual isolated labs do not independently establish immune grades.
NCCP pregnancy/ILD are cautions/consultant decisions, not blanket source exclusions.

00812.indication: Metastatic or locally advanced CSCC not suitable for curative surgery or curative radiation; adult,ECOG0–2,at least1measurablelesion. No adjuvant CSCC in NCCPv3a.
00812.preserve_shared_context: Cervical00812-gyn remains recurrent/metastatic cancer progressing on/after platinum. Measurable-CSCC criterion and CSCC transplant caution must not become cervical prerequisites; cervical platinum criterion must not apply to CSCC.

schedule.duration: Until progression or unacceptable toxicity; no preset totalcycles
schedule.card_tracking: Open-ended numbered cycle log rather than a finite completion stamp target

tests.imaging: Individual treatment plan; no NCCP fixed scanning or tumour-marker timetable.
tests.after_treatment: Continue to report new immune-type symptoms after stopping; this NCCP does not specify a universal fixed post-treatment blood-test timetable.

supportive_care.risk: Minimal emetogenic potential; no routine premedication; local policy.
supportive_care.immune_toxicity: Organ-specific specialist corticosteroids/hormone replacement where indicated. Resume only after source recovery/stability and consultant decision; do not automatically prescribe steroid rescue.

consent_risks: Transplant rejection risk discussion in CSCC solid-organ recipients
Potential serious/fatal and delayed immune reactions
00812.reproductive: Pregnancy/breastfeeding excluded in source; effective contraception during and at least4months after treatment.
assessment_distinctions: First grade3 colitis held; recurrent grade3 permanently stops.
Grade3 nephritis permanently stops (00431 grade3 holds).
Grade4 named endocrinopathy is not automatically a permanent stop: source allows recovery/stability pathway.
Grade2rash lasting>7days holds; exact7days does not trigger thatdurationrow.
Persistentgrade2/3non-endocrine≥12weeks and failure to taper systemicsteroid≤10mg/day within12weeks permanently stop.
00812.evidence_attribution: Migden advanced-CSCC study cited on p7 is the CSCC evidence source; cervical survival evidence from Tewari must not be reused as CSCC comparative survival evidence. Do not add adjuvant benefit based on a later indication outside NCCPv3a.
